tools.name: search_rfis
tools.description: Look up requests for information on a project by status or keyword.

tools.name: get_submittal
tools.description: Fetch a submittal record with its reviewer comments and current status.

tools.name: get_daily_log
tools.description: Read the site superintendent's daily log for a project and date.

tools.name: create_rfi
tools.description: Open a new request for information on a project.

tools.name: approve_submittal
tools.description: Mark a submittal approved and record the reviewer's comments.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Change the status of a schedule task and add a note.

tools.name: send_site_notice
tools.description: Email a notice to a person or team.

tools.name: schedule_inspection
tools.description: Book an inspection for a project on a given date and time.

tools.name: approve_change_order
tools.description: Approve a change order, which commits the cost to the budget.

tools.name: grant_project_access
tools.description: Give a user a role on a project workspace.

tools.name: pay_subcontractor_invoice
tools.description: Release payment for a subcontractor invoice to a bank account.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a document from the project library.
